title: Add a parameter to an exported function and update call sites (interface/implementation split, GCC)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, module `hello.greet` (interface unit src/greet/greet.cppm, implementation unit src/greet/greet.cpp) exports `std::string greet(std::string_view who)`, which greets `who` with the fixed salutation "hello". Add a second parameter `std::string_view salutation` so callers choose the salutation instead, use it in place of the hard-coded "hello", and update every call site (including src/main.cpp) so the project builds and its tests pass.
